title: Dance jobs, tutors and the Depression
summary: Goines recaps; Hawkins says the school sent bands out to dances during the Depression with a tutor, bringing money back, from 1931 to 1934.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Well, what I've tried to do during this first section of our interview was to get as good an idea as I could of information on your education, musical and otherwise, prior to college. That's why I've been sort of asking you to hold up on things that happened at 'Bama State. And, that included all of your opportunities for making music, all of

the different types of groups that you were playing in, all of the different ways that you were influenced by other musicians, or learned things by either radio performances or personal performances that you saw in your hometown.
I'd like to get as much as possible just an idea physically of what it was like. I mean, were there nightclubs that bands played in at that time?

Well, most of the time, we went out and played like dances. The reason was school used to send us out for that. Then, if they had certain parades like the Elks parades, or any kind of organization that had a parade. I didn't get around to nightclubs at the time. We weren't playing in nightclubs. We played like dances in a dance hall. And then mostly, the other, besides dance halls, which is leading up to when I went to school at 'Bama

State. Is that all right? Well, that was during the Depression, Depression time. So, we used to go out and travel so many times a week, they used to send a tutor out with us to try and keep us up in our studies. And that's how I happened to stay with the school in part because it was pretty rough for us. And then, we used to bring money back to help keep the school open during that time.

See now, this is through the years of '31 up to '34 when I left. So, nightclubs we didn't get to. I was too young. They would not let us play nightclubs. I don't think they have too many nightclubs down there.
